item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":32,"end_unit":33,"fact_summary":"Mexico's nuclear policy legally prioritizes peaceful applications and nuclear, radiation, and physical safety; the report states the government committed to maintaining and increasing safety, with CNSNS coordinating regulation and CFE responsible for safe operation of Laguna Verde.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.5","1B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The report covers 2019-2021; it describes the institutional posture inherited and operating into the target period, not a distinct 2023 decision.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the framework to Mexican constitutional law, SENER, CNSNS, CFE, and the federal government; it does not identify López Obrador as the personal decision-maker.","limitations":["Government self-report.","No direct evidence here of López Obrador's personal intervention or of all 2023 implementation outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":36,"end_unit":39,"fact_summary":"Mexico maintained a nuclear regulatory system with technical but not full legal-administrative independence: CNSNS was subordinate to SENER but had delegated authority and technical autonomy; the report acknowledges that greater de jure autonomy was still needed. Staffing constraints and knowledge-management gaps remained, although CNSNS reported sufficient personnel and a developing safety-culture project.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.7","1B.10","4B.4","8B.4","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Evidence concerns 2019-2021 conditions and planned follow-up before 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the structure and constraints to SENER, CNSNS, and government staffing and savings policies, not specifically to López Obrador.","limitations":["The source reports institutional claims and unresolved recommendations together.","It does not establish whether the president personally directed or corrected these conditions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":38,"end_unit":40,"fact_summary":"Mexico discontinued plans for three new nuclear units in the 2019-2033 update, while continuing existing-plant safety work; CNSNS had not fully achieved legal independence, its knowledge-management plan remained unfinished, and severe-accident guidelines were being followed up through drills.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.3","1B.4","1B.7","1B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report records the updated program through 2021 and planned completion or follow-up extending into 2022-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the nuclear-program update to SENER and the safety actions to CNSNS and CFE; no personal López Obrador attribution is supplied.","limitations":["Program discontinuation may reflect resource or policy choice, but the source does not state the president's motive.","The report is retrospective and government-authored."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":50,"end_unit":55,"fact_summary":"Laguna Verde operated under extensive safety-improvement and corrective-action systems, including root-cause analysis, safety-culture ambassadors, waste and spent-fuel planning, succession planning, post-Fukushima mitigation, and a reported 98% completion rate for post-Fukushima actions scheduled for completion by the end of 2023.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.3","1B.7","1B.8","1B.10","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Most measures predate 2023; the report explicitly gives end-2023 as the planned completion date for remaining post-Fukushima actions.","ruler_attribution":"Actions are attributed primarily to CFE and CNSNS, under Mexican government regulatory requirements; no direct presidential attribution.","limitations":["Completion percentage is a government-reported figure.","The source does not verify whether all actions were completed by the end of 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":69,"end_unit":72,"fact_summary":"CNSNS had inspection, enforcement, sanction, closure, and fine powers, but inspections found multiple non-compliances at Laguna Verde; a 2019 fine was imposed on CFE, while additional sanction proceedings from earlier inspections were still being prepared or expected to begin in 2022.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.8","1B.10","7B.2","7B.7","7B.9","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The enforcement history spans the 2017-2022 period and provides context for 2023 institutional enforcement capacity.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes enforcement to CNSNS and violations to CFE; it does not attribute the violations or sanctions personally to López Obrador.","limitations":["The source does not state the final disposition of all pending proceedings.","Findings concern the operator and regulator rather than the president personally."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":91,"end_unit":95,"fact_summary":"CNSNS used transparency laws and INFOMEX to provide public information and reported technical independence, but remained administratively subordinate to SENER; prior international reviews had recommended stronger independence, broader regulation, independent public communication, improved inspection, training, and financial resources, with some actions still incomplete.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.7","1B.10","4B.4","4B.6","6B.5","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report describes the institutional status during 2019-2021 and continuing unresolved reforms relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the arrangements to CNSNS, SENER, and federal laws; it does not identify López Obrador as personally responsible.","limitations":["Public-access mechanisms are described, but their practical completeness and independence are not independently assessed.","The source is self-reported."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":102,"end_unit":111,"fact_summary":"CFE and CNSNS maintained formal nuclear-safety policies, quarterly or annual monitoring, self-assessments, external peer reviews, corrective actions, quality systems, and a CNSNS code emphasizing safety, cooperation, open communication, continuous improvement, and self-assessment.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.7","1B.8","1B.10","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The systems were operating during 2019-2021 and designed for continuing use beyond the reporting period.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes these measures to CFE management, CNSNS, IAEA-supported programs, and federal regulation; no personal presidential attribution.","limitations":["Reported policies and monitoring do not by themselves prove effective implementation in every instance.","The source does not connect these systems to López Obrador's personal conduct."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":121,"end_unit":130,"fact_summary":"The government funded Laguna Verde safety operations, decommissioning and waste provisions, training, and a 1,400-person nuclear workforce; however, the report also identifies historical loss of experienced personnel, a need to consolidate knowledge management, limited nuclear education, and reduced technical training during the pandemic.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.7","1B.10","5B.6","6B.4","6B.9","8B.3","8B.4","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The evidence covers 2019-2022 and provides operating context for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Funding and staffing are attributed to the federal government, CFE, CNSNS, and government policies; no direct López Obrador attribution.","limitations":["Budget adequacy is asserted by the report and not independently evaluated.","The source does not establish whether staffing choices were personally made by the president."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":140,"end_unit":142,"fact_summary":"CNSNS reviewed human-factors controls and root causes, but no inspections specifically focused on human and organizational factors were conducted at Laguna Verde during 2019-2021; the report states such inspections should occur if organizational or equipment changes arise.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.7","1B.8","1B.10","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers 2019-2021, with implications for continuing oversight in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the inspection decision and framework to CNSNS; no presidential attribution.","limitations":["No inspection during the period is a concrete oversight gap, but the source does not establish resulting harm.","The report does not explain why the inspections were not conducted."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":230,"end_unit":237,"fact_summary":"Emergency exercises and evaluations produced identified improvements in training, population information, hospitals and shelters, and command-and-control; however, a 2019 integrated exercise generated 78 findings and the planned 2021 follow-up exercise was rescheduled to 2022.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.8","1B.10","3B.9","6B.6","8B.5","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The evidence covers 2019-2022 and concerns preparedness relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Actions and findings are attributed to CNSNS, CFE, federal and Veracruz authorities; no personal López Obrador attribution.","limitations":["The source says findings did not represent a population risk during the exercise response, but does not report final closure of all findings.","The report is self-reported."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":268,"end_unit":270,"fact_summary":"By the report date, Laguna Verde had completed reliable spent-fuel-pool instrumentation, hardened venting, and many mitigation measures, but FLEX Phase 3 remained in development, a conclusion report for some measures was pending, and CNSNS continued quarterly verification.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.8","1B.10","8B.6","8B.8","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report describes the status at the end of 2021 and continuing work expected to extend toward 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes implementation to CFE under CNSNS requirements and review; no direct presidential attribution.","limitations":["The source does not provide a verified end-2023 status.","The remaining gap concerns a specialized nuclear preparedness program, not overall national existential-risk posture."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":291,"end_unit":300,"fact_summary":"Laguna Verde reported multiple safety-significant events during 2019-2021 involving equipment failures, procedural omissions, human error, radiation-area access failures, and design or maintenance weaknesses; events were reported, investigated, and subjected to corrective-action and regulatory review, with no reported personnel dose in one access incident.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.8","1B.10","7B.1","7B.2","7B.7","8B.6","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers the 2019-2021 reporting period; it is relevant to 2023 as inherited operational evidence.","ruler_attribution":"Events and responses are attributed to CFE, LVNPS, and CNSNS; no evidence of López Obrador personally directing, concealing, or correcting them.","limitations":["The report gives examples of events and corrective processes but does not establish their final effectiveness.","The incident account is a government report and may not capture undisclosed events."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6f17aba60b2d38","start_unit":306,"end_unit":312,"fact_summary":"Mexico expanded spent-fuel storage through a 40-year-authorized independent facility and regulated radioactive-waste systems, but reported that some temporary waste storage was full or nearing capacity and that a new radioactive-waste storage facility was still under evaluation.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.10","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report describes storage conditions and plans through 2021-2022, relevant to 2023 continuity.","ruler_attribution":"Measures are attributed to CFE, CNSNS, SENER, and applicable regulations; no direct presidential attribution.","limitations":["The source does not quantify whether storage constraints created an immediate safety risk.","Future disposal capacity and 2023 implementation are not established."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied source is a Mexican government national report covering 2019-2021, with some 2022 status and 2023 planned milestones; it contains little direct evidence about López Obrador personally.","Most evidence concerns nuclear safety institutions and Laguna Verde rather than broader 2023 ruler-quality domains such as war, domestic violence, political freedom, economic policy, social welfare, or personal integrity.","Facts are attributed to institutions where the document does so; personal ruler attribution is not inferred from the president's formal constitutional position alone."]}
